name: benchflux_tutorial_data
description: A small tutorial dataset provided to demonstrate the BenchFlux benchmarking workflow and data formatting. It contains example tasks and sample inputs/outputs intended for testing evaluation pipelines rather than measuring real model capabilities. The dataset is mainly for pedagogical use and reproducibility demonstrations.
evaluation_method: accuracy (tutorial-oriented; may include other simple metrics depending on task)
reputation: Primarily a tutorial/resource dataset with low community adoption beyond those learning or demoing BenchFlux.
